variants.headline: A new government takes shape
variants.sub: The colony has a new government comprising {members}.
variants.body:
A new government comprising {members} has been formed. Its formation establishes an administration; it does not establish the success of its future decisions. In considering {target}, the useful distinction is between assembling a government and meeting the obligations that come with governing.

The gazette records the new government's formation as a matter of public administration. An account of the change should avoid presuming either the contents of its programme or the outcome of its work. The existence of a ministry and the adequacy of its conduct require separate consideration.

The position of {target} should be assessed through the responsibilities of formation without a verdict on decisions not yet established by this report. A new government is a fact, not a forecast. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: New ministry, practical obligations
variants.sub: A new government comprising {members} has been formed.
variants.body:
